notes.title: Slight pricing mistake yesterday
notes.content:
[Img]https://thumbs.gfycat.com/ImmenseResponsibleAracari-size_restricted.gif[/img]

[b]Hello everyone,[/b] 

I hope you're enjoying your relaxing journey in [b]Shape of the World[/b]. 

Unfortunately, there was a slight mistake yesterday: during the first hour of the release, the game was priced 14.99$ with a 15% discount [b]instead of 12.99$ with the same 15% discount.[/b] 

If you've paid too much, don't hesitate to ask Steam for a refund and buy it again at the right price (if you want). And if you've already played more than two hours, [b]don't hesitate to link this news[/b] in your Steam support request. 

Signing off on these beautiful screenshots by @rachel_scape and @David_Silbert!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30297296/7d5b299fc12bbe453de4e81e0ba3ce529feac5a7.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30297296/60fd0a165dfb3ac3bd5fd56cf1393343e0804533.png[/img]

Take care!

notes.title: Shape of the World available now! Prepare to... relax on your own psychedelic journey.
notes.content:
[img]https://thumbs.gfycat.com/CluelessCriminalFunnelweaverspider-size_restricted.gif[/img]

[h1]Hello everyone![/h1] 

[b]Shape of the World[/b] has officially hit the (digital) shelves here on Steam. I hope you will enjoy your odyssey and the peaceful ecosystem which awaits you. 


[img]https://thumbs.gfycat.com/ArcticClosedHalibut-size_restricted.gif[/img]

Four years after I started this project, I’m thrilled to finally be able to see other people interact and relax in Shape of the World. If you meet any bugs during your journey, please report it in the dedicated forum section [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/642610/discussions/1/]here[/url]. 

If you do some nice [b]screenshots[/b], I would love to see them posted here so everyone can enjoy it!

[b]Happy wandering[/b]!

[img]https://thumbs.gfycat.com/BareSilentAmericanwirehair-size_restricted.gif[/img]

[img]https://thumbs.gfycat.com/HighLittleBasil-size_restricted.gif[/img]

notes.title: Explore a technicolor forest in Shape of the World demo
notes.content:
Shape of the World is a new explore ’em up game that has all the colors and shapes you might want, if you’re a big fan of colors and shapes that make you feel things. Way back in 2014, Hollow Tree Games ran a successful Kickstarter to get SotW off the ground. Now it’s a reality. Or whatever we should call the trippy world made manifest here. Reality probably isn’t the term.

(more…)

notes.title: Release date and new launch trailer!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30297296/5d579e9b90e3266395fd4c8be2c3662e562ab833.jpg[/img]

[h1]Hello everyone,[/h1] 

After four years of developing [b]Shape of The World[/b], I’m stoked to finally announce a release date! Shape of the World will be available on June 5th 2018, for 12.99$, which also happens to be the [i]World Environment day[/i]. 

Since SotW is also a celebration of nature, I know it looks like a carefully planned release date! But, no, just a happy coincidence. 

Moving on, here is the new trailer I made for the occasion! 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HgAyec2XK0E&feature=youtu.be
And check out the [url=https://brentsilk.bandcamp.com/album/shape-of-the-world-sample]preview album[/url] by Brent Silk on Bandcamp!

Also, it would be amazing if you could tell any of your friends who you think might be up for a relaxing exploration game about Shape of the World.

Thanks!  
Stu

P.S. I dug up some old sketches from back when I was doing research for Shape of the World. I hope you like them!

notes.title: Shape of the World wandering into early 2018
notes.content: As a certified wanderer (50m silver certificate), I’ve been keeping an eye on Shape of the World [official site]. It’s a digiwalk through lands which reveal themselves as we stroll, trees growing, plants unfurling, and critters popping into sight, with the soundtrack shaped by our travels too. It looks a bit like Proteus mixed with something out the demoscene. The game’s already a year behind the plan from its successful 2015 Kickstarter, but the end is in sight. Developers Hollow Tree Games have now announced that Shape of the World is due some time in “early 2018”, and shared a wee new video with some wonderful wandering: (more…)
